summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload under it
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh/bun GitHub release assets into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes the Bun binary against a shipped sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line JavaScript bundle prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` using a rotated string-array decoder and hex identifiers; it is not referenced by the package's advertised entry point (jest-preset.js) and is only reachable through the preinstall dropper. The payload is staged to run under a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime so that Node-based install-time inspection does not naturally evaluate it. A Jest configuration preset has no functional reason to ship a Bun-only obfuscated bundle or to fetch and execute an alternate language runtime at install time. On `npm install`, this executes opaque attacker-staged code on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
